text:
olivia: Hey team — LogiCorp (merchant) flagged that several autopay invoices failed this morning. Customer sees the 3DS redirect but the flow returns without a challenge and the charge gets a hard decline. They provided one tx_id: tx_20240415_8243. Can we triage?
maya: Ack — which gateway? any acquirer info?
olivia: Using AcmePay (gateway: acmepay-eu). Merchant noticed it only for UK cards with VAT in metadata. Example from our logs: 2024-04-15T07:12:31Z tx_20240415_8243 -> api.request id=req-84a3, status=declined, reason="issuer_rejected:challenge_not_present"
dylan: I pulled the relay logs. ACS redirect returned a 204 and our client treated that as "no challenge" then flagged for additional fraud checks which caused decline. Snapshot:```
REQUEST id=req-84a3
POST /v1/payments/confirm
body: {"payment_method":"card","three_d_secure":true} 
RESP from acquirer: 204 No Content (acs_url followed, no challenge payload)
internal: fraud_score bumped to 92 -> auto-decline
```
sam: 204 from ACS is odd — should normally be a redirect to ACS with a challenge iframe or a 302 back. Could be an issuer bug returning an empty response. Do we have the raw browser redirect the merchant saw?
maya: Merchant screenshot attached in their ticket: shows brief flicker and then returns to merchant success page but payment failed. They say it happened on ~15% of attempts for same card.
olivia: I pushed a quick repro script to the tenant so support can run:```
export MERCHANT=logicorp
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/payments -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" -d '{"amount":1200,"currency":"GBP","card":{"number":"4000 0000 0000 3220","exp":"04/26","cvv":"737"},"three_d_secure":true}'
```
billing-bot: automated alert: payment.failed count=7 for merchant=logicorp window=1h top_reason=issuer_rejected:challenge_not_present
dylan: For now we can advise merchant to enable "3ds-challenge-fallback": route to redirectless auth when ACS returns non-200, and set retries=1. That reduces hard-declines while we debug issuer.
sam: Can eng-oncall look into why our ACS client treats 204 as no-challenge and immediately spikes fraud_score? Might be a regression from the 3ds client change last week (PR #4210). @dylan can you attach the raw acquirer responses and the kernel trace?
dylan: Attached logs and trace id trace-5591. Noticed we now call handleAcsResponse() which defaults to challenge=false on any non-HTML body. If ACS returns empty but also sets header X-ACS-Status: challenge_expected we should treat as challenge pending — looks like we ignore that header.
maya: Customer needs ETA — they want a temporary mitigation before EOD.
olivia: Action items: 1) @dylan open quick hotfix that treats 204 + X-ACS-Status header -> treat as challenge. 2) @sam escalate to eng-oncall if hotfix risky. 3) advise merchant to enable fallback and set retries. I'll update the ticket with repro steps and logs. :thumbsup:
sam: I'll assign eng-oncall and add to oncall queue, linking to incident: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2024-321
olivia: Thanks everyone — I'll post merchant update after we have a patch or clearer root cause. :eyes:
